scope: Negated cart requests: «no quiero un X» removes the line, past-tense swaps «no quería X, quería Y», explicit swaps with the agent on
trigger: Staging chat (05:35Z, previous deploy): after a wrong «1 Pollo Frito», «no quieria un pollo, queria el combo de arroz paisa» got a chicken variant list and «no quiero un pollo» got «Conservo 1 Pollo Frito en tu pedido»
baselineFindings: «no quiero un/el X» matched the quantity-correction regex «no quiero <qty> X» and kept the line («Conservo …»)
Past-tense swaps («no quería/queria/quieria/pedí X, quería Y») were not recognised as swaps; the family word opened a variant list
«no quiero X, quiero el combo de …» on menus without a «pollo combo» product went to the make-it-combo path («no veo una variante combo aparte»)

With the agent on, «no quiero el <line>, quiero <dish>» was taken by the multi-dish splitter before the agent and the swap fallback: it added the new dish, kept the old one and replied «no manejamos: no quiero …»
fix: rewriteNegatedCartRequest (in the pre-routing rewrite chain, cart not empty): «(yo) no quería/queria/quieria/pedí X, (era/sino) quería Y» becomes «no quiero X, quiero Y»; «(ya) no quiero/quería/pedí (un|el …) X» without quantity, second request or note words becomes «quita 1 <line>» (un/una) or «quita el <line>» (definite/bare) only when X matches exactly one cart line. tryApplyVariantPreferenceToProduct steps aside when the text names another catalog combo outright. tryHandleMultiProductOrder returns false for an explicit cart swap so the agent and the swap fallback handle it.

contrasts: present-tense swap still replaces the line
dish not in the cart removes nothing
two lines of the same family are not removed by the family word
two units: «un/una» removes one unit, «el/la» removes that line only
